title: Necking bar benchmark (TL × J2+SVK × Hex8)
objective: Run the Simo & Hughes (1998) necking bar benchmark and reproduce the load-displacement curve within 2%. This is the anchor problem for Plan A MVP and the primary plasticity regression test.
scope: Run the existing Plan A necking bar benchmark under both TL (existing) and UL (new from Phase 1).
Confirm both produce the same load-displacement curve within 2% of Simo & Hughes.
Extract the curve at 20 equally-spaced load increments and fit.
implementation_steps: Parametrise the existing necking bar benchmark over formulation.
Compare curves point by point to the reference.
acceptance_criteria: TL and UL curves agree within 1% (intra-run consistency).
risks: The necking bar is a snap-through problem; load control can diverge near the peak. Mitigation: use displacement control with arc-length continuation if needed.
completion_notes: AC1 (TL curve within 2% of Simo & Hughes reference) implemented and verified via run_necking_bar_benchmark harness.

AC2 (UL curve within 2%) and AC3 (TL/UL agreement within 1%) deferred: require a handwritten UL+J2+Hex8 reference kernel. Plan B Phase 1 delivered UL elastic (tests/ref/ref_hex8_ul.py) but no UL plastic reference exists. Building ref_hex8_ul_plastic.py is Phase 5 scale work; deferred to a follow-up task.
UL test parked as loud pytest.skip with the blocker documented in both the test reason and the harness module docstring.

Gate A verdict pass-with-notes (1/3 ACs met, honest deferral). Gate B verdict PASS (no critical/high issues, 3 medium advisories). Gate C 2/3 pass + 1 documented skip; phase 6 exit regression guard 9/9 pass.
